categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Anbiping Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on tumor screening and precise diagnosis. The company develops, manufactures, and sells tumor screening and diagnostic reagents, automated diagnostic equipment, and AI-assisted diagnostic software, mainly serving pathology departments. It also provides pathology co-construction services and digital pathology solutions, integrating products and services for comprehensive pathology diagnostics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including liquid-based cytology (LBP), polymerase chain reaction (PCR), immunohistochemistry (IHC), and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). It emphasizes automated, standardized, digital, and intelligent pathology workflows, with proprietary reagent and equipment development, AI-assisted diagnostic algorithms, and digital pathology systems. Production follows a 'make-to-order plus reasonable inventory' model with strict quality control and process management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 2,400 medical institutions across China, including more than 1,300 tertiary hospitals and 900 top-tier hospitals. The company serves pathology departments primarily in hospitals, medical laboratories, and healthcare networks, with a focus on tumor screening and diagnosis. It also targets grassroots hospitals through pathology co-construction and digital pathology services, and is expanding into international markets such as Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across China, covering all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It has a strong presence in South China, East China, North China, Northwest, Central, Southwest, and Northeast regions. Additionally, it has begun international expansion with market access and product registrations in countries including Japan, Vietnam, the European Union, Ukraine, and Ecuador.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anbiping operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic reagents and equipment. It also provides pathology diagnostic services and digital pathology solutions, integrating upstream technology with downstream clinical application and service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in tumor screening and precise diagnosis, emphasizing multi-technology and multi-target joint detection solutions. Key R&D directions include AI-assisted cytology, automated immunohistochemistry, FISH probe customization, digital pathology systems, and companion diagnostics. It invests heavily in innovation, clinical translation, and collaboration with hospitals and pharmaceutical companies to enhance product pipelines and expand digital and intelligent pathology capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of in vitro diagnostic reagents and diagnostic instruments, combined with service income from pathology co-construction and diagnostic services. The company employs a mixed sales model of direct sales and distribution channels, serving hospitals and medical institutions. It also earns income from licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anbiping is positioned as one of the leading domestic companies in tumor screening and precise diagnosis within the IVD industry. It holds a competitive edge with a comprehensive technology platform covering cytology, molecular, and immunodiagnostics, and a broad product portfolio with numerous regulatory approvals. The company competes with international brands and domestic peers, leveraging cost advantages, technological innovation, and integrated service models.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 470.79 million, a slight decrease of 5.33% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.29 million, down 46.85%. R&D investment accounted for 12.76% of revenue. Despite short-term profit decline due to pricing pressure and increased sales expenses, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 1.36 billion and continues to invest in growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anbiping offers integrated tumor screening and diagnostic solutions combining reagents, automated equipment, digital pathology, and AI-assisted diagnosis, providing high accuracy and efficiency. Its multi-technology platform enables comprehensive pathology diagnostics from cytology to molecular and protein levels. The company emphasizes product quality, regulatory compliance, and service excellence, supporting clinical decision-making and addressing pathology resource shortages, especially in grassroots hospitals.
